objective: Separate create and update audit ownership and make Authentication.Actor a direct accessor after authentication validation.
acceptance_criteria: Create operations set only CreatedActorType and CreatedActorID.
Update operations set only UpdatedActorType and UpdatedActorID.
Authentication.IsAuthenticated validates the durable actor for every authentication type.
Authentication.Scope rejects authentication with a missing or invalid actor.
Authentication.Actor returns ActorIdentity without an error result.
Service writes access actor values directly after authentication or scope validation.
affected_paths: pkg/types and client call sites of Authentication.Actor
all audited service create and update paths
